title: SfdcPartnerOrderBillingTrxn - Data API
description: Represents the junction between SfdcPartnerOrder and SfdcPartnerBillingTrxn in a Partner Business Org (PBO). This allows for a many-to-many relationship between the two objects and is used as the customer facing link between Orders and Stripe invoice data. This object is available in API version 66.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The auto-generated transaction name that uses the format: SPOBT-{00000000}.

PartnerBillingTransactionId.description: The Stripe invoice ID. This field is a relationship field.

SfdcPartnerOrderId.description: The ID of the associated partner order. This field is a relationship field.
